lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Earl Bae is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: 🕯️ Earl Bae is dead — sickness. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Earl kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Earl's gone." Mauricio looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Earl." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Anjali blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d40: The village's quarrel was with Earl — and Earl is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

d40: The fire knew Anjali before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
